question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Fish out of water
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 2.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Fish out of water"** means to feel uncomfortable or out of place in a particular situation. (असहज या अस्थानिक महसूस करना) • **Example:** He felt like a** fish out of water **at the formal dinner party. • **"To be out of place"** refers to feeling uncomfortable or not fitting in a particular situation or environment. (असहज महसूस करना) • **Example:** She looked **out of place** in her casual clothes at the black-tie event. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **To die soon** (जल्दी मरना): To pass away in a short period of time. • **Example:** The doctor said he might die soon due to his critical condition. • **No knowledge of marine life** (समुद्री जीवन के बारे में कोई ज्ञान नहीं): Lack of information or understanding about sea creatures and marine ecosystems. • **Example:** He has no knowledge of marine life, which made the aquarium tour quite enlightening for him. • **Not good at swimming** (तैरने में अच्छा नहीं): Lacking skill or proficiency in swimming. • **Example:** Despite living near the beach, he is not good at swimming. 40:Tcdf, The correct answer is: **Option 2.**
